result.instructions: Tools for CentrixOne, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the CentrixOne contacts in list 999 whose company contains Acme."; "Which CentrixOne users own the opportunities in list 999?"; "Add a contact with the company name Acme and put them in list 999.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CentrixOne data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run centrixone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run centrixone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run centrixone_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. centrixone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: centrixone_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List CentrixOne contacts with their list memberships (the ContactScript table). Use basic_filter for a contact, an external id or a list; add one filter_field condition to narrow further. Endpoint: GET Contacts-<account>-<apiKey>-<basic>.awp.

basic_filter.description: Basic filter: "all" (default), a contact id such as "C1234", an external id "E9999", a contact list "S999", or several joined by commas such as "C1234, C125".

filter_field.description: Field to compare, for example company. Give filter_field, filter_operator and filter_value together.

filter_operator.description: Comparison operator, exactly as CentrixOne documents it: =, <>, <, >, <=, >=, [=, =], [=].

filter_value.description: Value to compare. CentrixOne compares case-insensitively.

fields.description: Field names to return, comma-separated. Default "all". Call with "all" once to learn the field names.

tools.name: centrixone_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the account (CentrixOne calls them scripts). Use the list ids in centrixone_list_contacts and centrixone_upsert_contact. Endpoint: GET Scripts-<account>-<apiKey>.awp.

fields.description: Field names to return, comma-separated. Default "all". Call with "all" once to learn the field names.

tools.name: centrixone_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the CentrixOne users (sales representatives) of the account. Use them to find who owns a contact or an opportunity. Endpoint: GET Users-<account>-<apiKey>-all.awp.

fields.description: Field names to return, comma-separated. Default "all". Call with "all" once to learn the field names.

tools.name: centrixone_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities with their stage and value. basic_filter selects the list (for example "S999") or "all" (default). Endpoint: GET Opportunities-<account>-<apiKey>-<basic>.awp.

basic_filter.description: Basic filter: "all" (default), a contact id such as "C1234", an external id "E9999", a contact list "S999", or several joined by commas such as "C1234, C125".

fields.description: Field names to return, comma-separated. Default "all". Call with "all" once to learn the field names.

tools.name: centrixone_list_revenue_types
tools.title: List revenue types
tools.description: List the revenue types of the account at one level: 1 = RevenueTypes, 2 = RevenueTypesSub1, 3 = RevenueTypesSub2. Endpoint: GET RevenueTypes[Sub1|Sub2]-<account>-<apiKey>-all.awp.

level.description: 1 for top-level revenue types, 2 for the first sub-level, 3 for the second sub-level.

fields.description: Field names to return, comma-separated. Default "all". Call with "all" once to learn the field names.

tools.name: centrixone_upsert_contact
tools.title: Add or edit a contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or edit one, in CentrixOne. Pass contact_id to edit a known contact, or external_id to match your own id; with neither, a new contact is created. Fields you omit keep their value; an empty string clears a field. list_id adds the contact to a list. Endpoint: POST Contacts-<account>-<apiKey>-C.awp.

contact_id.description: CentrixOne contact id (the number after C, for example 1234).

external_id.description: Your own id for the contact (ExternalID).

fields.description: Contact field values by field name, for example {"company": "Acme"}. An empty string clears the field.

list_id.description: Contact list id (the number after S). The contact becomes a member of this list.
